_comment: Copy to settings.json and edit. settings.json is git-ignored, so your paths and model choices stay local to your machine.
_comment_vault: Both keys point at the same Obsidian vault; leave them equal unless you know why not. Optional — SkynetClaw runs without a vault.
_comment_models: Reasoning models. Any Ollama tag works; swap for a cloud model via .env if you prefer.
_comment_exec: The execution path — tool calls and file edits. Prefer a small, fast model here: the model that reasons does not have to be the model that executes.
